name: Orca Mobile Android mobile-android-v0.0.65
body:
## This is the last update for this app

Orca for Android has moved to a new app, `dev.orca.app`. It's on [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=dev.orca.app), and as an APK on [GitHub](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/releases/tag/android-v0.0.65) for phones without Play.

This app (`com.stably.orca.mobile`) won't get any more updates after this one, including security fixes. The new app is separate, so it can't update this one in place. You need to install it once, and from then on it updates itself.

### What this update does

- When you open Orca, it shows you how to move to the new app.
- Its name on your home screen is now **Orca (old)**, so you can tell the two apart.

### Switching to the new app

- Install the new app from Google Play. If your phone doesn't have Play, download the APK from the [new app's release](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/releases/tag/android-v0.0.65). It installs next to this one.
- Pair it: in Orca on your computer, go to **Settings → Mobile** and scan the code.
- Delete **Orca (old)** once your agents show up in the new app.

Your agents, chats and workspaces are saved on your computer, so you'll see them all in the new app.

Not ready to switch? This app keeps working. Tap **Keep using this version** and we'll remind you in a week.

## What's new

- A new Agents tab shows every agent across your computers.
- Sessions show one tab at a time, with a list of all open tabs.
- Dictation keeps going after you leave a session.
- Drafts and chats are kept when the app closes.
- Diffs and code use GitHub-style layout and colors.
- Photos are resized before upload, and HEIC photos are converted to JPEG.
- Fixes for chat, terminal and pairing.

Some of these need the latest Orca on your computer.

### Verify your download

- Size: `145844644` bytes
- SHA-256: `780b4c83dcada2e9ca647ea33e9d4015830af8a4917a64ede04e097ee24a0c78`

A "no certificate" or "problem parsing the package" install failure is usually a truncated download — check the size first, then `sha256sum -c app-release.apk.sha256` (`shasum -a 256 -c` on macOS).

body:
## Orca for Android has moved to a new app

This is the new Orca app for Android (`dev.orca.app`). It's the same build as the one on [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=dev.orca.app).

**If you installed Orca from GitHub, you need to install this APK.** The old app (`com.stably.orca.mobile`) gets no more updates, including security fixes. This is a separate app, so it installs next to the old one instead of updating it. Future GitHub releases will update this app.

If your phone has Google Play, install Orca from Play instead. Play keeps it up to date for you.

### Switching from the old app

- Install this APK. If your phone asks, allow your browser to install apps.
- Pair it: in Orca on your computer, go to **Settings → Mobile** and scan the code.
- Delete the old app once your agents show up in the new one.

Your agents, chats and workspaces are saved on your computer, so you'll see them all in the new app.

## What's new

- A new Agents tab shows every agent across your computers.
- Sessions show one tab at a time, with a list of all open tabs.
- Dictation keeps going after you leave a session.
- Drafts and chats are kept when the app closes.
- Diffs and code use GitHub-style layout and colors.
- Photos are resized before upload, and HEIC photos are converted to JPEG.
- Fixes for chat, terminal and pairing.

Some of these need the latest Orca on your computer.

### Verify your download

- Size: `146062171` bytes
- SHA-256: `44751078b3e89442f5d311664f7e83ce429a876abe2a7abe20e8e3ca29557c9b`
- Signing certificate SHA-256: `A0:A6:67:69:42:B2:DE:E1:F3:5F:B0:F6:FC:A0:AE:63:B5:65:4E:42:6C:A3:1A:DA:4C:F9:BE:09:2B:D7:DA:07`

A "no certificate" or "problem parsing the package" install failure is usually a truncated download — check the size first, then `sha256sum -c app-release.apk.sha256` (`shasum -a 256 -c` on macOS).

## Major performance improvements, automatic cleanup & focused subagent views ✨

Orca 1.4.259 improves performance across crowded sidebars, long chats and terminal restoration, and keeps Git reads moving while new workspaces are created. New cleanup controls help you manage the workspaces left behind.

- ⚡ **Smoother busy workspaces:** Crowded sidebars and long chat tool runs render only the visible rows, reducing rendering work and chat memory use. Terminal history restores without blocking the window on disk reads.
- 🧹 **Clear finished work on your terms:** Settings → Workspace Cleanup lets you review matching workspaces, enable automatic cleanup and inspect its activity. Give individual projects their own rules.
- 💬 **Follow one subagent at a time:** Open its task, live steps and final answer in a dedicated view, then return to the main conversation where you left off.
- 🤖 **Use Kimi Code in Chat:** Start a conversation with Kimi’s model picker, permission controls, questions and `/compact` support.
- 🎙️ **Watch dictation take shape:** Nemotron 3.5 now streams live text; Parakeet Unified EN adds an English-only streaming option. Optional AI cleanup handles punctuation and spoken corrections before insertion.
- 📱 **Find the phone tab that needs you:** The tab bar shows the open tab, a count and an add button. Tap the count for a grouped view of all tabs, including those waiting for your answer.

**Previous release: [1.4.258](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/releases/tag/v1.4.258)** — Smoother workspaces, restored phone scrolling and Copilot Chat.

## Highlights

- **Keep working while agents use tools:** Agent-created terminal splits keep your keyboard where it was. Browser popups and new-tab links opened by agents stay in the background. A server agent’s new browser tab can open on your paired desktop; without a paired desktop, it stays on the server.
- **Organize without stopping work:** Hide a project from the sidebar while its agents, terminals and automations keep running. Find it again under **Hidden projects**. On a shared paired server, hiding its project applies to everyone connected there.
- **Inspect long runs:** Expanded tool runs draw the visible rows while preserving Find, copying and keyboard navigation. Subagent rosters show each agent’s model, current work and result.

## Compatibility & upgrade notes

- **Cleanup is opt-in:** Rules start off. Review the deletion preview before enabling them; matching workspaces may be deleted within seconds of confirmation. Archive controls are not available.
- **Kimi Chat** requires Kimi Code **2.5.0+** and sign-in.
- **Voice:** Download Parakeet Unified EN in Voice settings to use it. AI cleanup is off by default and asks before sending dictated text, vocabulary and instructions to your selected agent. Failure or timeout inserts the original words. With simultaneous dictations, only one streams live.
- **Phone:** These changes include desktop-served phone pages; this desktop update does not install a native phone app. If prompted to **Update mobile**, update the phone app and reconnect.
- **Source Control:** The merged-workspace cleanup notice and its Delete Workspace action were withdrawn; earlier review-refresh and sleeping-workspace behavior is restored.

# HyperFrames v0.9.51

Released on 2026-11-15.

Render services can name extra networks their renders must treat as non-public, and mapped or NAT64 addresses are judged by the IPv4 address they carry. Website capture keeps Chrome's sandbox where the host supports it, and helper programs start only from trusted folders.

## Features

- **Engine:** Operators can add networks the render must treat as non-public ([b54f2079e](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/b54f2079ed715e69b10c6be54909030f64827a7a), [#7790](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7790)).

## Fixes

- **Engine:** Judge mapped and NAT64 addresses by the IPv4 they carry; producer exports the rule ([54e4a2be3](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/54e4a2be3e7a9fcf69b8b215ce0563f3900d2dd0), [#7789](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7789)).
- Docs image upload publishes only regular files, and CI rejects new symlinks ([9320c44e1](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/9320c44e130ab2fbd073599f576d0f42aa7e346d), [#7776](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7776)).
- **CLI and Studio server:** Received-file guard covers subfolders and spellings; playlists named as media never reach ffmpeg ([870b1fa4d](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/870b1fa4dc35436df9a3c1a3c902549e66565add), [#7771](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7771)).
- **CLI:** Keep Chrome's sandbox on for website capture where the host supports it ([27b195feb](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/27b195febcdfebe742b8eaaba51dcfadc27c5c45), [#7774](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7774)).
- **CLI:** Keep captured page text out of generated agent instruction files ([e4e93d6ed](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/e4e93d6ed9dfcd7e0e8a36fdd06ade64e196b729), [#7772](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7772)).
- **Engine:** Start nvidia-smi, vm_stat, ps and tasklist from trusted folders only ([e3ff9c803](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/e3ff9c803cd3bccdf39cf84f5bc36e52a61e1345), [#7788](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7788)).
- **Producer:** Every video's size samples share one grid ([1d83e2520](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/1d83e2520a27a445c8278237417cd90f0e002aea), [#7782](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7782)).

# HyperFrames v0.9.50

Released on 2026-11-15.

Renders now read only the media and files that belong to them, including every playlist a playlist names. Lambda renders reach only public addresses by default, like the other cloud render paths, and lint rules check large files faster.

## Fixes

- **AWS Lambda:** Lambda renders reach only public addresses unless the function opts out ([e8a59bf17](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/e8a59bf1774f9880109bb7a426c55825725feb74), [#7780](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7780)).
- **Engine:** Media playlists are checked through every list they name ([f4b6aad33](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/f4b6aad33251715e803e3bb84c24a0b446a5e956), [#7778](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7778)).
- **Engine:** Refuse media playlists that name files outside their folder ([06cf96464](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/06cf9646463596167a5b7e41f33fa1acdc5ced0f), [#7768](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7768)).
- Render file servers refuse env and Git files; shown-box sampling stays within the render ([603395c89](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/603395c89a680403f370be816331f1507dc9bd5c), [#7765](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7765)).
- **Producer:** Render-service media probes stay on public HTTPS ([0e767d620](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/0e767d620f630c4993e9b12364ae6d1e11f24421), [#7764](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7764)).

## Performance

- **Lint:** Rules scan script, style and comment blocks in linear time ([12832e3a9](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/12832e3a98138b45b94a376f9f324cb44667c5ba), [#7770](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7770)).

name: v18.20.1
body:
## @oh-my-pi/pi-agent-core

### Fixed

- Corrected context cost estimates for requests that omit reasoning history, so billing estimates now include thinking text only when it is sent or reconstructed for a tool call.

## @oh-my-pi/pi-ai

### Added

- Added `setUnpausedProviders()` to `@oh-my-pi/pi-ai/oauth`, allowing applications to re-enable providers paused by authentication rules; loaded credential pools and extension logins recognize the change on their next read.

### Changed

- Updated Vertex AI Gemini requests to use the v1beta1 API, restoring support for long Gemini responses.
- Improved Google Antigravity quota recovery so Gemini 4 Argon access can resume after quota or plan changes when shared Gemini capacity is available.
- Improved Amazon Bedrock region selection to honor a configured regional endpoint before falling back to `us-east-1`.

### Fixed

- Fixed Gemini 4 responses that exceed a single output segment across Google, Vertex AI, Gemini CLI, and Antigravity, ensuring long responses continue generating and are delivered as one complete reply.
- Fixed Cursor conversations so hook-added prompt content remains in the current user message and conversation context is correctly preserved across turns.
- Fixed Amazon Bedrock streaming so malformed responses fail promptly and interrupted responses are retried rather than treated as complete.
- Fixed Claude account recovery when usage reports contain only one shared usage window.
- Fixed OpenRouter conversations with Kimi and DeepSeek so reasoning context is preserved when switching models.
- Fixed Xiaomi MiMo Token Plan authentication to use the correct regional endpoint, including for models loaded from bundled or cached configuration.
- Fixed Perplexity sign-in in the login flow and setup wizard, including email-code and browser-based SSO authentication.
- Stopped native judges from retrying gateway errors caused by exhausted upstream credentials while retaining retries for other transient 502 errors.
- Fixed simple completion and authenticated gateway chat routes so supported providers receive stop-sequence and frequency-penalty settings.
- Fixed Muse sessions after credential changes, key rotation, or idle resume so subsequent turns can continue normally.

## @oh-my-pi/pi-catalog

### Added

- Added Gemini 4 Hydrogen on Google Antigravity as a single model with selectable low, medium, high, and xhigh thinking levels, priced at $1.50/$7.50 per million tokens.
- Added Chutes provider support with live model discovery and `/login chutes` authentication using `CHUTES_API_KEY`.

### Changed

- Paused Google Antigravity: login is no longer available and stored credentials are not used until the provider is re-enabled. Use `GEMINI_API_KEY` with Google AI Studio or the `google-vertex` provider instead ([#18341](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/18341)).
- Updated Command Code model pricing and usage reporting to match the provider's current rates, including long-context pricing tiers for Claude Haiku 5.5, GPT-6.1 Sol and Terra, Grok 4.7, and Claude Sonnet 5.5.
- Increased the maximum output for Gemini 4 Argon, Carbon, and Hydrogen on the Gemini API and Vertex AI to 262,144 tokens, enabling substantially longer responses.
- Updated OpenCode Go Claude Haiku 5.5 to support thinking levels from low through max, including explicit thinking disablement.
- Updated Devin requests to identify as Devin CLI 3000.12.57, the current stable version.

### Fixed

- Fixed Gemini 4 Argon on Command Code so image attachments are preserved and usage is billed correctly at $2 per million input tokens, $10 per million output tokens, and $0.10 per million cache-read tokens ([#19125](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/19125) by [@wolfiesch](https://github.com/wolfiesch)).
- Fixed Factory Droid GPT-6 models failing on the next turn after changing the thinking level during Bedrock or Snowflake sessions ([#19188](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/19188) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz)).
- Fixed OpenRouter model listings for workspace-restricted API keys so each key shows its correct allowed model roster and maintains an independent model cache ([#19013](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/19013) by [@YibaiMeng](https://github.com/YibaiMeng)).
- Fixed OpenCode Go Muse Spark tool-call turns losing encrypted reasoning between steps ([#17748](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17748) by [@nico2525nn](https://github.com/nico2525nn)).
- Fixed Vertex AI Gemini 3 and newer models rejecting replayed or cross-model tool calls that lack a thought signature ([#17150](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17150) by [@duck1eee](https://github.com/duck1eee)).
- Fixed Cursor model listings omitting models available to the provider, including GLM 5.3 and Grok 4.7 ([#18248](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18248) by [@joseotaviorf](https://github.com/joseotaviorf)).

## @oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent

### Added

- Added `/commit` to create commits containing only changes made by the agent or a selected subagent, while preserving other agents’ and the user’s work. The workflow is also available through the eval `commit` namespace, supports targeting repositories outside the session directory, handles binary and non-UTF-8 files, symlinks, file mode changes, and initial commits, and can optionally skip commit hooks with `no_verify`; use `commit.enabled` to disable it.
- Added `auth.unpausedProviders` (the **Unpaused Providers** setting) to re-enable paused providers such as Google Antigravity at your own risk while preserving their stored login state.
- Added configurable long-turn todo reminders through `todo.midRunNudges`, including options to disable reminders, limit them to two, or continue with increasing intervals.
- Pasting styled content into the composer now preserves Markdown formatting and places embedded images at their original positions, while code copied from editors remains plain text.
- Added the `session_clear` hook and extension event, emitted when `/clear` resets the current session context without changing its session ID.
- Added path-scoped Bash allow rules, project and configuration overlay precedence, and environment-variable controls through `bash.allowedEnvVars` and per-rule `env` settings.
- Subagents now preserve `@upstream` provider pinning when inheriting models.
- Added deletion of individual prompts from Ctrl+R history with the Delete key.
- Added `--no-judge`, `--no-spotlight`, and `--offline` options to restrict or disable auxiliary services outside the active model’s provider.
- Added per-rule TTSR `repeatMode` settings (`once`, `after-gap`, or `always`) to control reminder repetition.
- Bash approval prompts now show compound command segments individually and identify which segments are allowed or require approval.
- Todo `done`, `drop`, and `rm` operations now accept multiple tasks in a single request, including newline-, semicolon-, comma-, or space-separated input without splitting exact task-name matches.
- Todo status lines now display task counts when multiple targets are involved.

### Changed

- `/fork` and fork-from-transcript now abort an active response and fork immediately.
- Reduced default `grep` output by showing only matching lines and limiting matches per file; configure `grep.contextBefore` and `grep.contextAfter` to include surrounding context.
- Changed the default `spotlight.thinking` level from `low` to `med` for deeper result analysis and improved ranking, at a higher request cost.
- When Spotlight is enabled, commonly reread source and issue or pull-request content is shown more completely before outlining, including support for additional source file types.

### Fixed

- `/loop` now pauses after a provider error such as a rate limit instead of resubmitting the same prompt and attaching its `@file` mentions again ([#19272](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/19272)).
- Resuming a session whose directory was deleted now continues in the current directory with a warning instead of failing.
- Model mentions and `/switch` completions now recover discovered models after provider discovery fails at startup, retrying discovery when needed.
- Background job results that arrive after an ACP prompt ends are now carried into the next prompt instead of starting an invisible turn.
- OpenAI server compaction failures now proceed to the next available compaction method instead of retrying server compaction on another model.
- Language servers now recognize edits made shortly after a file is created, including on macOS.
- Bash commands displayed in the Pseudo shell view now remain accurate while streaming through heredocs, substitutions, loops, continuations, arithmetic expressions, and background execution.
- Resuming a session or reviving a subagent after a retry fallback with a thinking suffix (e.g. `:xhigh`) now restores the primary model's own thinking level instead of keeping the fallback's ([#19273](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/19273)).

## @oh-my-pi/collab-web

### Fixed

- Fixed guests retaining stale agents, tool cards, and working state after a failed rejoin; guests now reliably restore the current session state when reconnecting.

## @oh-my-pi/pi-natives

### Breaking Changes

- Changed lsTree() to return { path, mode } entries instead of bare paths; mode matches git ls-tree output (for example, 100755 or 120000).

### Added

- Added noVerify to commitCreate() options to skip the pre-commit and commit-msg hooks, matching git commit --no-verify.
- Added optimistic concurrency and alternate-index support to commitCreate(), allowing commits to use a separate index and reject stale commits when HEAD has changed.
- Improved grep() and glob() performance for ovnfs checkouts by using the serving daemon when available while preserving native fallback behavior and existing streaming, filtering, and link-following options.

### Changed

- Improved shell search across local and network filesystems: local searches avoid unexpectedly traversing network mounts, network-backed searches perform more directory operations concurrently, and fd supports parallel traversal together with ignore, pruning, depth, worker, and error-reporting options.

### Fixed

- Fixed binary patches produced by diffText({ binary: true }) and diffNoIndex(…, true) for non-UTF-8 text, such as Latin-1, so patches preserve the original bytes and apply correctly.
- Fixed SVG rendering when a generic font family refers to an unavailable font, preventing <text> elements from disappearing.
- Fixed worktree add for source checkouts containing read-only files or directories, including cases where tracked directories are replaced by symlinks.
- Fixed cancelled and timed-out Shell.run calls so they terminate only jobs started by that invocation while preserving the shell session for later runs.
- Reduced memory usage when visualizing long multi-line shell commands.
- Fixed the shell cp builtin so symlink-following options work correctly with archive and directory-copy modes without disabling recursion or attribute preservation.
- Replaced built-in shell crashes on very long -a/-o chains in [ ] and test expressions with a clear error for excessively deep expressions.

## @oh-my-pi/omp-stats

### Fixed

- Fixed Traces tab timing so background jobs show their actual completion times, including accurate idle periods and turn durations.
- Fixed per-model message counts on the Frustration page to include all answered messages.
- Improved dashboard responsiveness by keeping other pages and Live status available while Spotlight rebuilds.
- Fixed daily usage charts to group activity by the user's local calendar day instead of UTC.

## @oh-my-pi/pi-tui

### Added

- Added task counts to the Todo status line when work is assigned to multiple targets.
- Preserved pasted images when copying Composer drafts in Tern.
- Added the ability to delete the selected prompt from history by pressing Delete at the end of the Ctrl+R search field.
- Added distinct theming for Markdown links using registered extension schemes, with a muted fallback for themes that do not define the new color.
- Improved compound Bash command approval dialogs by distinguishing allowed and approval-required segments and opening at the first segment requiring approval.
- Added an optional Branch action to chat, including the `b` shortcut in the BTW history sheet.

### Fixed

- Fixed asynchronous Bash commands switching from the interpreted shell view to the raw command line.
- Improved transcript rendering when switching to a subagent, resuming a session, or rebuilding a long transcript so the newest messages appear immediately.
- Fixed Markdown task lists displaying the wrong checkbox state for completed and open items.
- Fixed iTerm2 inserting terminal resize data into the composer when reporting in-band resizes.
- Improved working-row animation while waiting for tools or models on terminals without synchronized output, including tmux 3.6.
- Fixed expanded IRC tool cards to show complete soft-wrapped output and added an expand hint to collapsed cards containing hidden text.
- Fixed premature scrolling in the `/resume` session picker when navigating near the middle of the list.

## @oh-my-pi/pi-utils

### Added

- Added `mixHex` for blending two hexadecimal colors.

### Fixed

- Improved extraction of Cloud Code Assist quota reset information, including compound durations and reset timestamps, to provide more accurate retry guidance.

name: v0.22.7
body:
# oh-my-codex v0.22.7

## Summary

This patch release ships updated agent guidance: prioritizing complete, maintainable repairs over minimal-diff patches.

## Changed

- **PRIORITIZE COMPLETE, MAINTAINABLE REPAIRS IN AGENT GUIDANCE (#4083):** Agent repair guidelines now emphasize choosing complete, correct solutions at natural ownership boundaries instead of minimizing diff size. This aligns agent behavior with maintainability practices: deletion over addition, boundary repair over new layers, and documented mitigations where appropriate. Updated guidance appears in system prompts (`prompts/team-executor.md`, `prompts/build-fixer.md`), agent templates (`templates/AGENTS.md`, `plugins/oh-my-codex/templates/AGENTS.md`), and skill documentation (`skills/ultrawork/references/agent-tiers.md`, `docs/shared/agent-tiers.md`). Fixes #4082.

## Compatibility

No breaking API changes. Release-coupled metadata (`package.json`, `package-lock.json`, Cargo workspace, and plugin metadata) all report `0.22.7`.

## Verification

- Full CI on dev candidate (candidate details recorded in [release readiness](docs/qa/release-readiness-0.22.7.md)).
- PR #4083 CI passed on its merged head.

## Contributors

Thanks to [@Yeachan-Heo](https://github.com/Yeachan-Heo) for contributing to this release.

**Full Changelog**: [`v0.22.6...v0.22.7`](https://github.com/Yeachan-Heo/oh-my-codex/compare/v0.22.6...v0.22.7)

name: openclaw 2026.11.5-beta.3
body:
## 2026.11.5-beta.3

### Highlights

- **Large-session reliability:** reduce memory pressure during transcript indexing, trimming, and compaction; stream only selected hydration payloads and honor configurable summary limits. (#194099, #194066, #194536, #196207) Thanks @vincentkoc, @aniruddhaadak80, @RomneyDa, @garrytan.
- **Restart and delivery safety:** preserve queued-message permission ceilings and accepted ingress during restarts, drain final chat writes before handoff, and retain delivery ownership through the final RPC. (#196540, #196923, #196493, #197427) Thanks @joshavant, @vincentkoc.
- **Recovery and setup:** improve cold-start initialization, interrupted workspace recovery, installer permissions, and actionable iMessage Automation status. (#192552, #196423, #186782, #186117) Thanks @javiermv, @anmol0b, @RomneyDa, @vincentkoc.

### Changes

- **Models and tools:** restore context-sized default output budgets, expose effective deferred MCP tools with bounded input hints, and deduplicate wrapped structured MCP results. (#193899, #196766, #196252, #196266, #196243) Thanks @RomneyDa, @jalehman, @GrahamMcBain, @VACInc, @vincentkoc.
- **Compaction:** support a configurable summary-character limit while retaining foreground request-budget constraints and redacting credentials in quoted summary content. (#196207, #197349) Thanks @aniruddhaadak80, @RomneyDa, @garrytan, @obviyus.
- **Browser and workspaces:** route Lightpanda navigation through its supported connection path and wait for sandbox files to become ready. (#196400, #197248) Thanks @RomneyDa, @mmaps.

### Fixes

- **Startup and updates:** retry transient shared-state schema admission, defer cold-start runtime initialization, preserve external-plugin data during update rehearsals, keep idle cron workers disabled, and split timed-out SQLite header probes. Conflicting legacy exec-approval files no longer prevent startup; canonical policy remains authoritative. (#195398, #192552, #196301, #196387, #193970, #194239, #196401) Thanks @RomneyDa, @vincentkoc.
- **Sessions and storage:** bound large-transcript indexing and trimming, stream selected compaction payloads, exclude consumed inputs from actor hydration, and recover cold PostgreSQL conversations after readers close. Preserve active turns across session rollover, settle suspended descendants, and repair persisted internal-wake titles. (#194099, #194066, #194536, #196277, #189991, #197345, #197323, #196362) Thanks @vincentkoc, @etzelm, @Jo2234, @obviyus, @abacha, @wr-web, @xRyann2255, @RomneyDa.
- **Authority and delivery:** require effective authority for delegated changes, apply input-policy hooks to prepared images, preserve accepted queued ingress and original permissions through restart, and wait for final writes within the existing restart budget. Keep final-delivery ownership until its RPC settles. (#196984, #196337, #196923, #196540, #196493, #197427) Thanks @joshavant, @vincentkoc, @RomneyDa.
- **Execution and progress:** collect process results at suspended capacity, retain accepted ClawHub attempts after timeouts, settle failed Code Mode calls without unresolved sibling waits, and detect silent model streams despite tool heartbeats. Bound silent Agents API startup and release retained completion authority for finished non-announcing children. (#196927, #196929, #196435, #196517, #196672) Thanks @RomneyDa.
- **Channels:** retain iMessage Automation warnings until an accepted send, avoid Slack reasoning-stream freezes, handle empty IRC channel sender lists, and preserve local final replies in history. Cron and system replies no longer use closed plugin scopes. (#186117, #196250, #196293, #187795, #196750) Thanks @MertBasar0, @anmol0b, @RomneyDa, @mmaps, @masatohoshino, @obviyus, @ptu-gh.
- **Provider setup:** retain Z.ai Coding Plan catalog models, deduplicate concurrent provider-catalog imports, preserve model API billing settings during config writes, recover cancelled Claude CLI login refreshes, and omit enums from non-string Gemini parameter schemas. (#195390, #196448, #191326, #197032, #196742) Thanks @jason-allen-oneal, @1052326311, @WG-Mojo, @etzelm, @obviyus, @kir1ll, @vincentkoc, @RomneyDa.
- **Diagnostics:** avoid repeated redaction and serialization during opt-in OpenTelemetry content capture, bound oversized image capture, and redact raw multiline strings before JSON escaping. (#186666, #194353) Thanks @651juan, @amittell, @mmaps.
- **Platform recovery:** compare Windows state paths case-insensitively, respect installer permission masks, and recover macOS LaunchAgents when Trash access is denied. Keep iOS gateway recovery reachable while reconnecting and remove legacy plaintext setup-code preferences; pasted setup codes stay in memory. (#185917, #186782, #189321, #191560, #197049) Thanks @YangManBOBO, @javiermv, @sukhdeepjohar, @obviyus, @TameTheGame, @RomneyDa, @vincentkoc.
- **Workspace and database recovery:** recover interrupted workspace turns, avoid false admission after resumed database copies, and keep stopped-database Doctor inspection read-only on full disks. Open nested repositories outside mirror paths correctly. (#196423, #194595, #196346, #196747) Thanks @mmaps, @ylcn91, @reisball, @fuller-stack-dev.
- **Interface and release routing:** keep session links and row actions usable on touch devices, avoid freezes from deep-path progress labels, and reject incompatible release routes. (#194840, #196282, #196878) Thanks @RomneyDa, @najef1979-code, @vyctorbrzezowski, @LeizhenZhang, @obviyus.

### Complete contribution record

This audited record covers the complete v2026.11.5-beta.2..7f4704ecaf79dc747db8d7c73c614ccd08204acd history: 50 in-range PRs + 0 retained seed-only PRs = 50 unique PRs. The generation manifest also supplies direct commits as editorial input; the grouped notes above prioritize user impact.

name: CC Switch v4.0.32
body:
# CC Switch v4.0.32

本版本新增**后台自动下载更新**：在「设置 → 关于」打开「自动下载更新」后，新版本会在后台下载并校验好，右下角弹出提示问你是否安装，不会未经确认就重启。「设置 → 网络」新增 **IP 检测**，可以查看 CC Switch 经全局代理、临时代理或当前网络访问时的出口 IP 和所在地区。

另外修复了 Codex 经路由换供应商续接旧会话后，上游先回 200 再报「无法解密」导致整轮报废；Codex 经路由或聚合接 Mistral AI 时请求报 422；CC Switch 内部某个操作崩溃一次后，托盘变空、切不了供应商，直到重启；用 mise 装的工具在「应用」页显示两条安装记录等问题。

**[English →](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/blob/main/docs/release-notes/v4.0.32-en.md) | [日本語版 →](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/blob/main/docs/release-notes/v4.0.32-ja.md)**

---

## 新增

### 后台自动下载更新

「设置 → 关于」新增「自动下载更新」开关，默认关闭，每台设备单独设置。

- 打开后，CC Switch 启动一分钟后检查一次，之后每六小时检查一次，有新版本就在后台下载并校验。
- 下载好后，主界面右下角会问你是否安装。安装会重启 CC Switch，正在经本地路由的请求会中断，所以一定要你点「安装并重启」才会进行；路由开着时提示里会写明这一点。
- 点「稍后」只是不再为这个版本弹提示，设置里的红点、「关于」页的按钮，以及托盘菜单和快捷面板里新增的「重启并更新到 vX」仍然可以安装。
- 便携版和 Linux 的 deb / rpm 安装包不能自动安装，开关会置灰并说明原因。

### IP 检测

「设置 → 网络」在全局代理下方新增 IP 检测（[#9449](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/9449)，需求见 [#9448](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/9448)）：选已保存的全局代理或填一个临时代理（只用于这次检测，不保存），点「检测 IP」后会显示出口 IP、两个检测服务的结果是否一致，以及国家或地区、城市、运营商等信息。没设全局代理时，按系统代理或直连检测；指定了代理时，代理连不上不会改用直连。

- 只在点击后运行，会访问 icanhazip.com、ipify.org，并把测得的 IP 发给 ipwho.is 查询位置。
- 测的是 CC Switch 自己经这条线路的出口，不一定等于 Claude Code、Codex 等客户端的出口。

### 其他

- **GitHub Copilot 反代供应商卡片显示绑定的 GitHub 账号**（[#9228](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/9228)，需求见 [#9480](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/9480)）：以前只显示 GitHub Copilot 的官网地址，多个账号时分不清。没绑定时显示授权中心的默认账号，填了备注时备注优先。

---

## 修复

- **Codex 经路由换供应商续接旧会话时，上游先回 200、再报「Encrypted function output content could not be decrypted or decoded」，Codex 重连五次后这一轮报废**（[#9476](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/9476)）：请求里带着上一家生成的思考记录或加密内容时，CC Switch 会先等上游开始输出再交给 Codex，这时被拒就去掉这些内容后在同一家自动重试一次，会话可以继续。不带这类内容的请求照常直接流式返回。
- **Codex 经路由或聚合接 Mistral AI 时，请求报 422 `extra_forbidden`**（[#9507](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/9507)）：Codex 带的 Responses 专用字段、为 Mistral 上的 DeepSeek / GLM 模型自动加的思考参数，以及用过工具之后每轮都带的 `reasoning_content`，发往 `api.mistral.ai` 时都会去掉。其他上游不受影响。
- **CC Switch 内部某个操作崩溃一次后，托盘菜单变空、切不了供应商，退出时也恢复不了直连，只能重启**（[#9472](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/9472)、[#9483](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/9483)，见 [#8058](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/8058)）：数据库、设置、配置文件写入、MCP、提示词、价格、备份等操作现在都能在崩溃后恢复，崩溃时没写完的改动会回滚。
- **经 GitHub Copilot 用 Claude Code / Claude Desktop 时，Grok 这类在 Copilot 里只支持 Responses 接口的模型报「not accessible via the /chat/completions endpoint」**（[#6954](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/6954)、[#9473](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/9473)）：这类模型现在改走 Responses 接口，两种接口都支持的模型不变。
- **Antigravity 选 Orchestrator 时，用量全部记在一个虚拟模型名下、费用为 0**（[#9493](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/9493)、[#9494](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/9494)）：现在按每一步实际使用的模型计价，并新增 Gemini 4 Hydrogen 的价格。已导入的 Antigravity 历史会重新解析一次，补上费用。
- **开启「统一 Codex 会话历史」或迁移历史后，几个月前的会话在 `codex resume` 里排到了最前面**（[#3866](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/3866)、[#9471](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/9471)）：改写普通 `.jsonl` 会话文件时会保留原来的修改时间，压缩过的文件本来就会保留。已经被改乱的修改时间不会恢复。
- **在 Hermes 里删掉的供应商，CC Switch 里删除按钮一直是灰的**（[#4816](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/4816)、[#9470](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/9470)）：Hermes 里已经没有的供应商现在可以编辑和删除；读不到 Hermes 配置时仍然锁定。
- **从预设新增 OpenClaw 供应商时，`/model` 里列的是预设自带的模型，不是表单里最后保存的**（[#9474](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/9474)，见 [#6729](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/6729)）：在表单里删掉的模型不会再出现，新加的模型也能选；不改动预设直接保存时，会登记预设的全部模型。编辑已有供应商时还不会同步，#6729 仍在跟进。
- **用 mise 安装的工具，「应用」页显示两条安装记录（mise 用 Homebrew 安装时其中一条标成 homebrew）**（[#9515](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/9515)）：mise 的 shim 现在算作它实际指向的那个安装。
- **窗口较矮时，「打开终端」对话框的确认按钮被挤出屏幕，点不到**（[#9478](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/9478)）：对话框内容可以单独滚动，按钮固定在底部；在「附加参数（可选）」输入框里按回车也可以直接打开终端。
- **用量页的汇率状态缺句号，和后面的说明连在一起**（[#9436](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/9436)）。

---

## 致谢

感谢 @khazic（IP 检测）、@SaladDay（数据库锁崩溃后恢复、Copilot 只支持 Responses 的模型、Codex 会话修改时间、Hermes 已删供应商、OpenClaw 模型登记，以及应用能力表、托管账号判定、预设模型列表去重和清理无用代码等内部整理）、@YUZHEthefool（设置与配置锁崩溃后恢复）、@Yanxcyan（数据库锁恢复的最初方案）、@ziyangxiami、@lyfuci（Antigravity Orchestrator 计价）、@allenxu09（Antigravity Orchestrator 计价、配置锁崩溃后恢复）、@anysdk2023（Copilot 卡片显示账号）、@jantodec（Codex 接 Mistral 的 422）、@minimote（汇率状态句号）、@1clipse（用量图表数字格式）的贡献。

感谢 @JinLin-Yu、@Swcmb、@w-up、@CWY963725470、@mangohl、@h0pely、@xiaoqiu5307-max、@hueifeng 报告问题和提供复现信息。

完整的技术细节请见 [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)。

name: @openviking/react 0.1.12
body:
## en-US

### Patch Changes

- Connect Console HITL question parsing, ordered answers and conversation continuation. Display and copy readable answer summaries while preserving protocol payloads for transport and storage.
- Support per-question field validators, control renderers and custom cards. Preserve input for retry after failed submissions and discard obsolete interactions when reloading or switching sessions.
- Unify HITL labels, help text, error tips and invalid-control icons. Clear local errors when input values change.
- Preserve drafts across HITL Previous/Next navigation and schedule-frequency changes, and submit all steps once.
- Provide themed, keyboard-accessible time selection with scrolling and wheel input, preserving HH:mm values, validation and disabled states. Prevent overlapping hour and minute updates from reverting one another.
- Standalone VikingBotInteraction no longer requires Ark Design. Import its dedicated stylesheet from `@openviking/react/components/viking-bot/interaction/style.css`.
- HITL text requests honor single-line and multiline modes.
- Export ContextPicker for controlled file and directory selection, search, single or independent multiple selection, asynchronous selection restoration and custom footer actions.
- Built-in directory interactions support ancestor expansion, pagination, child-directory creation, host-provided permissions and validation. Custom answers can delegate selection to the host.
- Reuse TanStack Query v5 clients through OpenVikingProvider, with per-endpoint concurrency and identity-scoped directory and search caches supplied by the default SDK runtime. Preserve rows after background refresh failures and invalidate caches after writes.
- Add optional, strongly typed analytics and frontend monitoring through OpenVikingProvider, both disabled by default. Cover interactions, outcomes, viewport exposure, component and request failures, resources, streams and tasks, with instance identification, bounded traces and bilingual integration guides and event catalogues.
- Make FileBrowser directory navigation expand and refresh its target, support root navigation and preserve pagination, expanded branches and cached children during refresh failures. Keep preview-only navigation available through `reveal: false`, and restore the initially loaded L0/L1 tab indicator.
- Keep FileTree trailing actions visible during horizontal scrolling.
- Add independent FileTree dashboard tooltips and row-name titles.
- Remove FileTree row permission badges while retaining preview ACL indicators and permission controls.
- Let FileBrowser hosts override individual experience-dashboard requests.
- Show preview character counts, modification times and localized model notices.
- Save ordinary file edits directly; create annotated snapshots from Version history.
- Align the FileBrowser ACL picker, allow host-selected principal types and restore inheritance through supported gateway updates. Correct effective-grant attribution when inherited permissions exceed direct permissions.
- Preserve theme danger colors on FileBrowser delete actions.
- Improve advanced search with directory scopes and date ranges, retain results until the close animation ends, and preserve selected preview-tab colors on hover.
- Support resource uploads when the Console service provides attachment uploads, and wait for completion before sending. Cancel uploads and clear managed attachments when the chat identity, explicit session or request lifetime changes, while preserving them when the host echoes a newly created session ID.
- Keep quick inputs above the VikingBot composer and focus the editor when its blank area is clicked.
- Refine conversation timelines, code blocks and session actions, and improve narrow command panels.
- Adapt AgentConnect and ScopeSwitcher to narrow containers.
- Unify themed Checkbox, Radio and focus states, and preserve forced-color focus visibility.
- Share illustrated empty and render-error states.
- Unify operation and request errors with dismissible Notifications and local feedback with Toast. Preserve server reasons, drafts, cancellation and retries without duplicate notices.
- Copy full diagnostics, including available error codes, HTTP status and request IDs, and support loading feedback and notice updates.

Migration: mount components in the browser; SSR and hydration paths are no longer supported. HITL text questions now require non-blank input by default; set `required: false` for optional text. Single-question answer shapes are unchanged; multi-step answers use `steps`.

Remove the obsolete `FileTreeLabels.readOnly`, `noAccess` and `traverseOnly` overrides. FileTree trailing content defaults to `rowTrailingPosition: 'viewport-end'`; set `'row-end'` to retain the previous horizontal-scrolling behavior.

[Full changes](https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking/compare/react@0.1.11...react@0.1.12)

## zh-CN

### 修复与改进

- 接通 Console HITL 的问题解析、顺序作答、答案组装和继续对话。提交结果以可读摘要展示和复制，传输与存储保留协议原文。
- 支持按问题注入字段校验、控件渲染及自定义卡片。提交失败保留输入并允许重试，重载或切换会话时清除失效交互。
- 统一 HITL 标签、说明、错误 tips 和错误控件内的图标颜色，修改输入时清除本地错误。
- HITL 上一步、下一步及切换定时频次时保留草稿，最后一次性提交所有步骤。
- 时间选择支持主题、键盘、滚动列和滚轮操作，保留 HH:mm 值、校验及禁用状态。避免小时与分钟的交叠操作互相覆盖。
- 独立使用 VikingBotInteraction 不再需要 Ark Design，可从 `@openviking/react/components/viking-bot/interaction/style.css` 引入独立交互样式。
- HITL 文本请求按 multiline 配置显示单行或多行输入。
- 导出 ContextPicker，支持受控文件与目录选择、搜索、单选与独立多选、异步选中回显及自定义底部操作。
- 内置目录交互支持展开祖先、分页、新建子目录及宿主提供的权限和校验，自定义答案可将选择交给宿主。
- OpenVikingProvider 支持复用 TanStack Query v5 客户端、按接口配置并发，以及由 SDK 默认查询运行时提供的身份隔离目录与搜索缓存。后台刷新失败保留行数据，写入后使缓存失效。
- 通过 OpenVikingProvider 新增默认关闭、强类型的埋点与前端监控，覆盖操作、结果、可视曝光、组件与请求异常、资源、流和任务，提供实例标识、有容量限制的链路快照及双语接入指南和事件目录。
- FileBrowser 定位目录时自动展开并刷新目标，支持根目录定位，刷新失败时保留分页、展开分支和缓存子项。保留 `reveal: false` 的仅预览行为，并修复 L0/L1 页签首次加载后的选中指示条。
- FileTree 行尾操作在横向滚动时保持可见。
- FileTree 新增独立的看板图标提示和行名称 title。
- 移除 FileTree 行尾权限标识，保留预览 ACL 标签和权限控制。
- FileBrowser 允许宿主替换经验看板的单项请求。
- 预览页脚展示字符数、更新时间及本地化模型解析提示。
- 普通文件编辑直接保存，带备注的快照在「历史版本」中创建。
- 对齐 FileBrowser 权限选择器，允许宿主指定主体类型，并通过网关支持的更新接口恢复继承。修正继承权限高于直接权限时的有效授权来源。
- FileBrowser 删除操作保留主题警告色。
- 高级搜索支持目录范围与日期筛选，关闭动画结束后再清空结果，预览页签悬停时保留选中背景。
- Console 服务支持附件上传时，对话可添加资源，发送前等待上传完成。聊天身份、显式会话或请求生命周期变化时，取消上传并清空托管附件；宿主回写新建会话 ID 时保留正常上传。
- VikingBot 快捷输入常驻输入框上方，点击输入区空白处聚焦编辑器。
- 调整对话执行时间线、代码块和会话操作，改进窄屏命令面板。
- AgentConnect 和 ScopeSwitcher 适应窄容器。
- 统一跟随主题的 Checkbox、Radio 和焦点状态，保留高对比度焦点提示。
- 共用插画空态与渲染错误状态。
- 操作与请求错误统一使用可关闭的 Notification，本地反馈使用 Toast。保留服务端原因、草稿、取消和重试，避免重复通知。
- 支持复制完整诊断信息及已有的错误码、HTTP 状态码和 Request ID，并支持加载反馈和提示更新。

迁移说明：请在浏览器中挂载组件，不再支持 SSR 与 hydration 路径。HITL 文本题默认要求非空输入，可设置 `required: false` 保留可选文本行为。单题答案结构保持不变，多步骤答案使用 `steps`。

请删除已移除的 `FileTreeLabels.readOnly`、`noAccess` 和 `traverseOnly` 文案覆盖。FileTree 行尾内容默认采用 `rowTrailingPosition: 'viewport-end'`，如需保留原先随整行横向滚动的行为，请设置为 `'row-end'`。

[完整变更](https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking/compare/react@0.1.11...react@0.1.12)

name: v15.18.4
body:
## Fixes

- **Claude Code gets claude-mem's rules and tools once** (#6179). Before this, a Claude Code session got the same guidance from up to three places: the MCP server instructions, a memory block the local activation script wrote into `CLAUDE.md`, and a pointer line to `RULES-AND-TOOLS.md` (whose timeline legend was never actually loaded). Now there is one path. `MY-RULES.md`, which your `CLAUDE.md` already imports, ends with an import of `RULES-AND-TOOLS.md`, and Claude Code loads it from there.
  - When that import chain is complete in Claude Code, the MCP server sends no instructions, and the SessionStart hook drops the `Access Claude-Mem Rules + Tools:` pointer line. The server only skips its instructions when the imported file holds exactly the text it would send.
  - Other hosts, and Claude Code users who never set up My Rules, are unchanged.
  - The worker adds the import to an existing `MY-RULES.md` once at startup, so current users get it without doing anything. It never creates the file. Writing `MY-RULES.md` also makes sure `RULES-AND-TOOLS.md` exists, so the import never points at a missing file.
  - `scripts/activate-progressive-memory-local.mjs` no longer writes the memory block into Claude's `CLAUDE.md`. Codex `AGENTS.md` keeps it, because `AGENTS.md` has no imports.
- **Worker listing endpoints stop at offset 10,000** (#6083, thanks @xunguangzlj-cloud). `/api/observations`, `/api/summaries`, `/api/prompts`, the session feeds and `/api/tool-uses` used to pass any offset straight into SQLite, where a deep offset makes the database scan and throw away every skipped row. They now answer 400 above 10,000 with the same message the jobs listing uses. The viewer feeds mark their last page instead, so the viewer shows "this list stops at the newest 10,000 items" rather than an error.
- **Folders whose names start with two dots stay inside excluded directories** (#6062, thanks @Afloat16). A child folder named like `..cache` was mistaken for a parent-directory path, so it slipped past the exclusions for observer sessions, the plugin cache and the marketplace runtime, and a marker under Claude's config folder could become a project root.
- **Cost report uses your name, not the maintainer's** (#6085, thanks @MaxWang007). The remaining name-based checks ("Blocked on <name>", relays, human-review detection) take the name from `--owner-name`, then `ACR_OWNER_NAME`, then `git config user.name`, and use name-free patterns when none is set. A first name alone also matches, and non-Latin names work.

## Performance

- **Faster project-filtered session lists in the viewer** (#6053, thanks @Afloat16). A new index on project, start time and id lets the viewer read one page of a long project history without sorting every session. Existing databases get the index on the next worker start.
- **Lower peak memory during the near-duplicate sweep** (#6052, thanks @Afloat16). Pair counting now works one title at a time instead of holding every shared-title pair in memory. Results are the same.

## Docs and examples

- **Vercel Chat SDK example for explicit project memory** (#6084, thanks @Kirat0201). A local, bearer-authenticated chat can save a note, search its project and fetch an observation. No model and no automatic capture. It needs `CLAUDE_MEM_WORKER_URL` set, and the guide shows how to find your worker's port.
- README logo mark updated (#6104).

Automated release candidate build from `main`.\n\n**npm:** `npm install gitnexus@rc`\n**Version:** `1.6.13-rc.225`\n**Target base:** `1.6.13` (rc #225)\n**Source commit (main):** d6917308d5d09ef6fff59f33ffd727965011414e\n**Release commit (versioned tree):** 0ca8c8e9de18dc232a603e3fe99632064415ff10\n\nRelease candidates are pre-stable builds intended for early testing. Stable releases remain on the `latest` dist-tag.

### 🚨 Security

### 🏎️ Performance

### 👷 CI/CD

* workflow: triage reporting by @zander-raycraft in https://github.com/abhigyanpatwari/GitNexus/pull/421
### 📦 Dependencies

name: graphify 0.9.109
body:
- Fix: **csharp** a non-UTF-8 source file (Windows-1252/UTF-16) that contains a preprocessor directive is decoded before the directive is blanked, so a non-ASCII identifier is no longer cut short and later members are no longer dropped (#5194, thanks @JensD-git).
- Fix: **csharp** an explicit interface implementation (`void IFoo.Bar()`) is kept out of overload binding and gets its own node, so it no longer collapses with a public `Bar` overload, and calls dispatch to the correct member (#5193, thanks @JensD-git).
- Fix: **ids** members or functions of one scope whose names differ only by a leading/trailing `_`, or only by case, get distinct node ids instead of one swallowing the other, now in Kotlin (#5206), Swift (#5204), Dart (#5200) and C++ (including a constructor `Foo` vs destructor `~Foo`, and a trailing-underscore `name_`, #5202); a unique public name keeps the plain id and the twins are salted, as already done for Python, C#, Java and PHP (thanks @rohit-jsfreaky).
- Fix: **llm** when a per-chunk callback raises during parallel extraction, the remaining queued chunks are cancelled instead of continuing to run, so a failed run stops promptly without wasted model calls (#5187, thanks @MaxWang007).
- Fix: **extract** a per-file AST failure during an incremental build preserves the source's last good AST records instead of deleting them, marks the run incomplete, and clears the file's manifest hash so the next run re-attempts it (#5191, thanks @sdivyanshu90).
- Fix: **llm** a response carrying two or more independent graph fragments (or a multi-element array) is rejected and retried instead of caching only the first as if complete; a single object, or a single-element array wrapping one valid fragment, is still accepted (#5192, thanks @sdivyanshu90).
- Fix: **extract** under a symlinked scan root, an in-root file keeps its repo-relative `source_file` instead of collapsing to a bare basename (which merged distinct files into one and emptied the graph); only the parent is resolved, so a file symlink that #2832 keeps distinct still is (#4624, thanks @maruf-asterbyte).
- Fix: **extract** a variadic parameter references its element type (`xs ...T` in Go, `T... xs` in Java, `params T[]` in C#, `T*` in Scala, `...$xs` in PHP), instead of emitting no type edge (#4638, thanks @madhusudanpatnaik).
- Fix: **dart** a legacy typedef that returns a function type (`typedef int Function(int) Make();`) is named by its own declared name instead of by `Function` (#4641, thanks @madhusudanpatnaik).
- Fix: **skill** a file a semantic subagent dispatched but never reported a coverage entry for is treated as unread and re-dispatched, instead of being cached and stamped complete from nodes guessed off its name; the subagent prompt now asks for a coverage entry (0 = never opened) for every file (#2225, thanks @Kalessin-Roke).
The AST cache schema is bumped to 46; warm caches re-run the affected C#, Kotlin, Swift, Dart, C++, Go, Java, Scala and PHP extractions.

name: v2.2.0
body:
### Features
- feat: OMP (oh-my-pi) is the 11th supported agent (ADR-0026, #1332)
- feat: ADR-0023 omp row, PRD and TECH-SPEC 11 agents, 01-contracts and 12-plugins name OMP, intake reads OMP (OMP M8)
- feat: docs/install/omp.md with OMP's own verbs, omp in NATIVE_HOSTS, 11 agents in install docs and README (OMP M8)
- feat: ci.yml OMP 18.20.0 from its own install script on 3 OS, omp --version gate, OMP e2e cases step (OMP M7c)
- feat: omp row decodes the Pi payload with agent omp, rows say omp (OMP M7a)
- feat: ctx_upgrade on OMP prints omp plugin upgrade, writes no host config, one plugin root per package (OMP M6b)
- feat: doctor names OMP, reads the OMP plugin store, prints OMP verbs and host-limit info (OMP M6a)
- feat: setup merges and uninstall drops context-mode in OMP disabledServers when OMP imports it (OMP M5)
- feat: issue forms, intake, CI step name and windows-hosts list omp as the 11th agent (OMP M4b)
- feat: package.json omp key and omp/index.js wrapper (OMP M4b)
- feat: omp is the 11th AgentId with a Pi-shaped table row (OMP M4a)
- feat: all 9 ctx_* tools register with loadMode essential (OMP M3)
- feat: OMP reads contextMode.excludeTools from api.pi.settings per call (OMP M2c)
- feat: turn once per prompt, OMP registers tools at load (OMP M2b)
- feat: shared Pi factory takes the agent id from its entry, env never selects OMP (OMP M2a)
- feat: array systemPrompt keeps every OMP block, payload last, once (OMP M1)

### Fixes
- fix(ci): the OMP fire block runs in its own test file so the VS Code setup check keeps its 10 s MCP timer (D-OMP-CI-3, #1332)
- fix(ci): OMP CI on main, windows-hosts installs OMP; GP3 omp driver uses stdin (D-OMP-CI-2, #1332)
- fix(ci): windows-hosts job installs OMP with its own script; GP3 omp driver reads steps on stdin (D-OMP-CI-2)
- fix: safeFetch sends user-agent and accept on every request, a refused fetch names the host (#1380)
- fix: readme-stats writes the README counts line from stats.json (D-README-COUNTS-1)
- fix: readme-stats job rebases before its push, so README counts update daily (D-README-STATS-PUSH-1)
- fix: gemini doctor checks an installed extension from disk when the list fails (#1378)
- fix: doctor names the gemini list error for an installed extension (#1378)
- fix: doctor names a missing pinned codex hook or server path (#1376)
- fix: setup uses the codex plugin route when it runs from the plugin cache (#1376)
- fix: runProcess reads the pipes once more before an exit-drain cut (D-R59-D5-DRAIN-1)
- fix: a tools: mcp__<server>__* or mcp__<server> entry grants that server's ctx tools, so the subagent gets case A (#1374)
- fix: copilot-cli and vscode hook command starts with bare node on Windows so pwsh -Command parses it (#1375)
- fix(e2e): hook runner builds the child env from an allowlist, not the runner's process.env (D-E2E-HOST-ENV-1)
- fix(sandbox): a PATH candidate stat cannot read is skipped, lookup failures are named, D11 names a language it cannot resolve (#1373)

### Performance
- perf: doctor reads the omp plugin list once (OMP P5)

### Who gets this

One version on both channels: the release commit on main (GitHub) and npm.

| Agent | Channel | Update with |
|---|---|---|
| Claude Code | GitHub | `claude plugin update context-mode@context-mode` |
| Codex | GitHub, npm for the one-time hook trust step | `codex plugin marketplace upgrade context-mode` |
| Gemini CLI | GitHub | `gemini extensions update context-mode` |
| Qwen Code | GitHub | `qwen extensions update context-mode` |
| Copilot CLI | npm | `context-mode upgrade` |
| VS Code (Copilot) | npm | `context-mode upgrade` |
| Kiro | npm | `context-mode upgrade` |
| ZCode | GitHub | `zcode plugins update context-mode@context-mode` |
| Pi | npm | `pi update --extensions` |
| OpenCode | npm | `opencode plugin update` |
| OMP | npm | `omp plugin upgrade context-mode` |

## Install

macOS and Linux:

```bash
/bin/bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://cua.ai/driver/install.sh)"
```

Windows:

```powershell
irm https://cua.ai/driver/install.ps1 | iex
```

Cua Driver ships universal macOS binaries, x86_64 and arm64 Windows builds,
and Linux preview builds. Release assets also include tag-pinned installer and
uninstaller scripts.

## Why GitHub says “Pre-release”

GitHub's label is used only to keep this monorepo's repository-wide “Latest”
pointer from switching between independently released products. A plain Cua
Driver SemVer is a stable release; npm and PyPI publish it on
their normal stable channels, and the installers resolve the versioned
`cua-driver-rs-v*` releases directly.

# Cua Driver 0.51.4

## Summary

This release includes 1 fix.

## Fixes

- drop the success glyph from unconfirmed action text. ([#7806](https://github.com/trycua/cua/pull/7806)) reported by @ymehili.

## Contributors

Thanks to @ymehili for contributing to this release.

## Install

macOS and Linux:

```bash
/bin/bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://cua.ai/driver/install.sh)"
```

Windows:

```powershell
irm https://cua.ai/driver/install.ps1 | iex
```

Cua Driver ships universal macOS binaries, x86_64 and arm64 Windows builds,
and Linux preview builds. Release assets also include tag-pinned installer and
uninstaller scripts.

## Why GitHub says “Pre-release”

GitHub's label is used only to keep this monorepo's repository-wide “Latest”
pointer from switching between independently released products. A plain Cua
Driver SemVer is a stable release; npm and PyPI publish it on
their normal stable channels, and the installers resolve the versioned
`cua-driver-rs-v*` releases directly.

# Cua Driver 0.51.2

## Summary

This release includes 3 fixes.

## Fixes

- refuse macOS clicks when the observed control has changed. ([#7789](https://github.com/trycua/cua/pull/7789)) Thanks @muness.
- accept --socket on permissions again so the hosted macOS gate can read daemon permissions. ([#7796](https://github.com/trycua/cua/pull/7796))
- drop the nonexistent render --output from the recording usage error. ([#7795](https://github.com/trycua/cua/pull/7795)) reported by @coygeek.

## Reverts

- put each tool description's first sentence on its own line. ([#7790](https://github.com/trycua/cua/pull/7790))

## Contributors

Thanks to @coygeek, @muness for contributing to this release.

## Install

macOS and Linux:

```bash
/bin/bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://cua.ai/driver/install.sh)"
```

Windows:

```powershell
irm https://cua.ai/driver/install.ps1 | iex
```

Cua Driver ships universal macOS binaries, x86_64 and arm64 Windows builds,
and Linux preview builds. Release assets also include tag-pinned installer and
uninstaller scripts.

## Why GitHub says “Pre-release”

GitHub's label is used only to keep this monorepo's repository-wide “Latest”
pointer from switching between independently released products. A plain Cua
Driver SemVer is a stable release; npm and PyPI publish it on
their normal stable channels, and the installers resolve the versioned
`cua-driver-rs-v*` releases directly.
